summary: # Sections This file defines all sections, their ordering, impact levels, and descriptions. The section ID (in parentheses) is the filename prefix used to group rules. --- ## 1. Type System Performance (type) **Impact:** CRITICAL **Description:** Complex types, deep generics, and large unions cause quadratic compilation time. Simplifying type definitions yields the largest compile-time gains. ## 2. Compiler Configuration (tscfg) **Impact:** CRITICAL **Description:** Misconfigured tsconfig causes full rebuilds and unnecessary file scanning. Proper configuration reduces compile time by 50-80%.
